btcv.target: binary foreground formed from Synapse labels 1..8 after the recorded label remap
btcv.metric_policy: slice-level foreground Dice/IoU, excluding empty-ground-truth slices from aggregate means
btcv.normalization: CT window [-175,250], scaled to uint8 RGB and then [0,1]

acdc.target: three foreground channels: right ventricle, myocardium, left ventricle
acdc.metric_policy: slice/class foreground Dice/IoU for classes 1..3, excluding empty-ground-truth observations
acdc.normalization: per labelled ED/ES frame nonzero percentile clip [1,99], scaled to uint8 RGB and then [0,1]
acdc.post_processing: diffusion-sample foreground channels, threshold 0.5 then foreground argmax

isic2018.metric_policy: slice/image-level foreground Dice/IoU, excluding empty-ground-truth images from aggregate means

full.training_loss: epsilon MSE plus learned-variance VB term; local calibration loss is disabled
full.training_input: image, case-matched noisy mask Y_t, timestep t

train_random_yt.training_loss: unchanged epsilon MSE plus learned-variance VB term
train_random_yt.training_input: image, independent Gaussian tensor replacing only model-input Y_t, unchanged timestep t
train_random_yt.inference: same full reverse diffusion as Full

train_shuffle_yt.training_loss: unchanged epsilon MSE plus learned-variance VB term
train_shuffle_yt.training_input: image, Y_t built from another batch member's mask using the current sample's t and noise
train_shuffle_yt.inference: same full reverse diffusion as Full

core_no_diff.training_loss: binary BCEWithLogits plus soft Dice, or multiclass cross-entropy plus foreground soft Dice
core_no_diff.training_input: image only through the existing highway segmentation path
core_no_diff.inference: single image-only forward; no reverse diffusion
